Two algebraically checked positive decompositions prove denominator positivity for both orders of positive site rates, including endpoint reservoirs. The exact identity S D_swap - S_swap D = kappa(a-b)(u-v)P and P>0 yields a full all-drive iff/sign statement. An independent exact-fraction generator solver checked 1,600 cases, including endpoints. This is a finite corroboration, not an infinite proof; proof covers all positive rates and reservoir densities.

value.rationale: The smallest two-site exclusion channel is a natural stress test of recently studied sample-specific rectification, because it has interacting occupancies, two different waiting times and two reservoirs. The proof resolves the unknown exact sign and necessity/sufficiency boundary without a closure approximation across the entire admissible continuum, providing a predictive minimal-device benchmark. Its exact all-drive classification is stronger than a weak-gain approximation or a selected numeric example. It makes no unmotivated higher-dimensional or long-chain claim.
